runs.notes: Repository initialised; dnsdoctor 0.1.0 built with stdlib only (Go module proxy unreachable from the build sandbox). Local gofmt/vet/test -race pass; live DNS smoke test not possible from the sandbox (UDP/53 intercepted). First push refused (GitHub App not installed); pushed to main after the owner granted access.

Fewer than 3 tools, so no maintenance pass this run. tlsaudit 0.1.0 built with stdlib only (Go module proxy still unreachable). gofmt/vet/test -race pass locally against loopback TLS servers; live smoke test only possible through the sandbox's TLS-intercepting egress proxy.

Fewer than 3 tools before this run, so no maintenance pass. nftlint 0.1.0 built with the Python standard library only. ruff check/format and 84 pytest tests pass on Python 3.13 and 3.9; JSON fixtures generated with real nft 1.0.9 in an unprivileged network namespace, and --live verified against a kernel ruleset loaded in that namespace. Next run: 3 tools, so new tool (netcfg-diff) + maintenance of dnsdoctor (oldest).

netcfg-diff 0.1.0 built with the Python standard library only: ruff check/format and 52 pytest tests pass on Python 3.13 and 3.9 (including a Junos candidate-config simulator applying generated set/delete/insert commands over 500 random reorderings); 2x44k-line IOS diff in ~1.2s. Module named masking.py because the repository .gitignore excludes secrets.*. dnsdoctor maintenance (0.1.1): lame servers skipped during iterative and DNSSEC walks, explicit TCP fallback errors, regression tests; gofmt/vet/test -race pass. Next run: new tool pmtud-probe (P2 #5) + maintenance of tlsaudit (oldest).

Owner asked for Discord Rich Presence with the software logo. Added an original logo (assets/) and sysnet-presence 0.1.0 (stdlib Discord IPC client + command wrapper). ruff and 12 pytest tests pass on Python 3.13 and 3.9 against a fake IPC server; real Discord not testable from the cloud sandbox. Owner must create the Discord application, upload assets/logo-1024.png as art asset 'logo' and set SYSNET_DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.

pmtud-probe 0.1.0 built with the Go standard library only (module proxy still unreachable). gofmt/vet/test -race pass; 14-scenario netns lab (client/router/server, nftables black hole, MSS clamping, rejections) passes with both probe methods. The sandbox kernel has no IPv6, so IPv6 socket paths are covered by unit tests and run against ::1 only in CI. tlsaudit maintenance (0.1.1): duplicate Prometheus series with connect=, interrupted runs exit UNKNOWN without touching --prom-file, duplicate targets deduplicated, expiry colour follows thresholds; regression tests added. Next run: new tool lldp-mapper (P2 #6) + maintenance of nftlint (oldest).
